name: setup
description: Multi-target setup plugin — thin wrappers that drive the OFFICIAL installers for LifeOS (the Life Operating System), MuleSoft API-design skills, Salesforce agent skills, and the Dr JSkill Spring Boot generator. Nothing is vendored; each target fetches the upstream install at run time with permission. USE WHEN setup lifeos, install lifeos, /setup:lifeos, set up mulesoft skills, install anypoint api skills, /setup:mulesoft, set up salesforce skills, install agentforce skills, sf skills, /setup:salesforce, set up spring boot, install dr jskill, java project generator, /setup:springboot.
